Build from source.

The Rust toolchain is pinned via rust-toolchain.toml — rustup handles it automatically.

Dependencies

macOS

xcode-select --install

Arch

sudo pacman -S --needed rustup base-devel pkgconf libxkbcommon libxkbcommon-x11 \
  libxcb xcb-util-wm xcb-util-image xcb-util-keysyms xcb-util-renderutil \
  wayland alsa-lib fontconfig

Debian / Ubuntu

sudo apt-get install libxcb-xkb-dev libxkbcommon-dev libxkbcommon-x11-dev \
  libxcb-icccm4-dev libxcb-image0-dev libxcb-render0-dev libxcb-shape0-dev \
  libxcb-xfixes0-dev libxcb-keysyms1-dev libwayland-dev pkg-config

Windows — rustup + Visual Studio Build Tools ("Desktop development with C++" workload).

Build & run

git clone https://github.com/fireflylabss/abstract
cd abstract
cargo build --release
./target/release/abstract   # abstract.exe on Windows

Pass a folder to open it as the active space:

cargo run --release -- ~/notes

To try a build without touching your real settings, point the XDG variables at a scratch directory (Linux and macOS):

XDG_CONFIG_HOME=/tmp/abstract/config \
XDG_STATE_HOME=/tmp/abstract/state \
XDG_DATA_HOME=/tmp/abstract/data \
  ./target/release/abstract /tmp/abstract/notes

Development

cargo fmt --check
cargo clippy --all-targets -- -D warnings
cargo test
cargo build --release

CI runs the same checks on Linux and macOS.

Where things live

PathWhat it holds
src/app/The window: sidebar, toolbar, search, find bar, tour and updates UI
src/editor.rs, src/buffer.rsThe live editor and its text buffer, selection and undo
src/md.rs, src/code.rsMarkdown parsing and concealment, code highlighting
src/table.rs, src/footnote.rsTables and footnotes
src/links.rs, src/search.rs, src/find.rsWiki-links and backlinks, space search, find & replace
src/vault.rs, src/watch.rs, src/attach.rsThe note tree, file watching, attachments
src/store.rs, src/spaces.rsSettings, session and the list of spaces
src/theme.rs, src/i18n.rs, src/keymap.rsThemes, translations, shortcuts
assets/, packaging/Bundled fonts and icons, and the AUR package files
